comparison.objective: Candidate screens finishing media from washers; record serves a drink through a self-closing drive-thru window.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests controlled granular sifting and bridge release with a bimanually held screen; record tests holding a loaded slider while transferring an upright cup through an opening.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovered media mass, washer retention, spill avoidance and released screen seating; record grades cup placement, arm withdrawal and unobstructed window closure, with touch/tip/crush failures.
comparison.reason: The shared bimanual load-sharing primitive does not make window-and-cup coordination equivalent to aperture-based separation.
